defective_pattern: Inserting Latin script author names directly into Persian text (e.g., 'Smith و همکاران').
why_defective: Breaks Persian academic typographic standards which require phonetic transliteration in the body and original Latin script in footnotes.
observed_symptoms: English author names appearing mid-sentence in Persian paragraphs.
corrective_remedy: Transliterate author names into Persian script (e.g., 'اسمیت'). Place the Latin name ('Smith') in a footnote referenced immediately after the Persian transliteration.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Regex detecting Latin alphabetical characters [A-Za-z] inside Persian text paragraphs, specifically associated with citation contexts.
